analysis.summary: Manav Infra Projects Limited reported a total income of Rs. 4184.44 lacs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, compared to Rs. 2449.73 lacs in the previous year. The company plans to diversify into roads, highways, and real estate to reduce sector dependency and increase market share. Management has proposed re-appointments for key leadership roles and requested shareholder approval to increase borrowing limits to Rs.

demand_outlook.claim: The company intends to expand its presence in the roads, highways, and real estate sectors to reduce reliance on any single project type.
demand_outlook.quote: MIP has identified roads & highways, real estate and other heavy civil construction works as a potential growth segment. In the near future the Company is desirous of gradually improving its penetration and resources to these sectors. Such diversification in different sectors enables us to reduce dependence on any one sector or nature of the project.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the outlook is bright and the company is poised for sustained growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Your Company is poised for sustained growth and the outlook is bright.

demand_outlook.claim: The company identified roads and highways, real estate, and other heavy civil construction works as potential growth segments.
demand_outlook.quote: MIP has identified roads & highways, real estate and other heavy civil construction works as a potential growth segment.

orders_capacity.claim: The Nomination and Remuneration Committee considered the increase in work order position when approving revised remuneration for executive directors.
orders_capacity.quote: While approving the revised remuneration of the Executive Directors, the Nomination and Remuneration Committee considered various parameters which, inter alia, includes, the scale of operations of the Company especially in respect of increase of Work Order position etc.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is seeking shareholder approval to increase its borrowing limit to Rs. 20 crores to support business requirements and growth plans.
capital_allocation.quote: Keeping in view of the Company’s business requirements and growth plans, it is considered appropriate to increase the aforesaid limit of borrowing. Your consent is therefore sought to authorize the Board to borrow up to 20 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors did not recommend a dividend for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, citing future fund requirements.
capital_allocation.quote: Keeping in view the current financial position of the Company, economic scenario, in financial year 2025- 26. and the future fund requirements of the Company, your directors do not recommended any dividend for the financial year ended 31st March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company issued equity shares under a rights issue to existing equity shareholders during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Company has issued shares under Rights issue to the existing equity shareholders of the Company

capital_allocation.claim: The company took unsecured loans from directors Mr. Mahendra Narayan Raju and Mrs. Mahalakshmi Raju amounting to Rs. 19,663,998.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Company has taken unsecured loan from the Director of the Company , i.e. Mr. Mahendra Narayan Raju and Mrs. Mahalakshmi Raju amounting to Rs. 19,663,998/- .

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to increase its market share and overall presence in the construction industry.
management_commitments.quote: To enhance its in- house expertise, so as to be at par with the other eminent players in the construction industry and to broaden its operational base in specialized construction field, keeping in view the performance and future prospects, the Company will continue to increase its overall presence in the industry with increased market share.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Vipul Vishnu Awaghade was appointed as an Independent Director for a term of five consecutive years commencing from April 21, 2025 to April 20, 2030.
management_commitments.quote: Mr. Vipul Vishnu Awaghade (DIN: 07802786 ), who was appointed as an Independent, Additional Director of the Company by the Board of Directors dated April 21, 2025 effective from April 21, 2025 whose term of office expires at this Annual General Meeting (‘AGM’) and who has submitted a declaration that he meets the criteria for independence as provided in Section 149(6) of the Act, be and is hereby appointed as an Independent Director of the Company to hold office for a term of 5 (Five) consecutive years commencing from April 21, 2025 to April 20, 2030.

management_commitments.claim: M/s. P M Agarwal & Co. was appointed as the Secretarial Auditor of the Company for a period of five years commencing from financial year 2025-26 until F.Y. 2029-30.
management_commitments.quote: consent of the Company be and is hereby accorded for appointment of M/s. P M Agarwal & Co., Company Secretaries (COP: 19363) as the Secretarial Auditor of the Company for a period of five (5) years, commencing from financial year 2025-26, until F.Y. 2029-30 to conduct a Secretarial Audit of the Company and to furnish the Secretarial Audit Report.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
